tagline.en: Along the eastern foot of the Rockies, desert to prairie
tagline.zh: 沿落基山东麓，自荒漠到草原

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: Interstate 10 at Las Cruces, New Mexico
start.zh: 新墨西哥州拉斯克鲁塞斯，与 I-10 相接

end.zh: 怀俄明州布法罗，与 I-90 相接

en: I-25 runs the length of the Rockies' eastern foot, from the Chihuahuan Desert at Las Cruces to the Powder River Basin in northern Wyoming. It is the road that strings together every major city on the Front Range — Albuquerque, Santa Fe, Pueblo, Colorado Springs, Denver, Fort Collins, Cheyenne, Casper — and between them it is often empty in a way that surprises people who know only the Denver section.

It inherited the alignment of US 85 and US 87, which in turn inherited older routes. Between Santa Fe and Raton Pass it approximates the Santa Fe Trail, and the climb to Raton Pass was largely built on the grade of the old highway, which followed the nineteenth-century Wootton Toll Road. The route is not consistently north–south: leaving Santa Fe, northbound I-25 actually heads southeast for some 45 miles through the Santa Fe National Forest and over Glorieta Pass before turning north again.

The passes define the driving. Raton Pass on the New Mexico–Colorado line and Glorieta Pass in New Mexico are both around 7,500 feet, and Monument Hill between Colorado Springs and Denver is high enough to need a chain-up station and a truck climbing lane. North of Cheyenne the road empties out into high plains and ends at I-90 in Buffalo, without ever reaching a city of any size in its final three hundred miles.
zh: I-25 沿落基山东麓纵贯南北，从拉斯克鲁塞斯的奇瓦瓦沙漠一直到怀俄明州北部的粉河盆地。它把前岭地区所有主要城市串在一起——阿尔伯克基、圣菲、普韦布洛、科罗拉多斯普林斯、丹佛、柯林斯堡、夏延、卡斯珀——而城市之间的路段常常空旷得让只熟悉丹佛段的人意外。
它承接了 US 85 与 US 87 的线位，而后者又承接了更古老的道路。在圣菲与拉顿山口之间，它大致沿循圣菲古道；通往拉顿山口的爬坡段大体建在旧干线的路基上，而那条旧路又沿着十九世纪的伍顿收费路修筑。这条路线并非始终南北走向：出圣菲后，「北行」的 I-25 实际上向东南延伸约 45 英里，穿过圣菲国家森林、越过格洛列塔山口，之后才重新转向北。
山口决定了驾驶体验。新墨西哥—科罗拉多州界上的拉顿山口与新墨西哥境内的格洛列塔山口海拔均在 7,500 英尺上下；科罗拉多斯普林斯与丹佛之间的纪念碑山则高到需要设置装链站和货车爬坡车道。过夏延以北，道路进入高平原，最终止于布法罗的 I-90——在最后三百英里里，它未曾经过任何有规模的城市。

en: Parts of this road predate the Interstate programme. Denver began building the Valley Highway in 1948 and had it fully open by 1958; Pueblo's freeway was finished by July 1959 and Colorado Springs' Monument Valley Freeway, begun in 1955, by July 1960. The Interstate system then stitched these urban expressways together.

The first genuine state-line connection was northwards. Colorado's seventeen miles from north of Wellington to the border and Wyoming's nine-mile link on to Cheyenne were built between July 1962 and October 1964. The southern link was much harder: the climb from Trinidad to Raton Pass gains about 1,800 feet in thirteen miles. Surveying began in 1959, construction started at the summit in 1960 and worked downhill, the route through Trinidad opened to two-way traffic in 1963, and the last elevated viaduct there was not finished until 1968.

Colorado's section was completed on Sunday 21 September 1969, when a 21-mile stretch between Walsenburg and Trinidad was dedicated at the Rugby Rest Area, midway between the two towns. That opening gave four continuous lanes for the 299 miles from New Mexico to Wyoming.
zh: 这条路的部分路段早于州际公路计划。丹佛于 1948 年开工修建河谷高速公路，1958 年全线通车；普韦布洛的高速公路于 1959 年 7 月建成；科罗拉多斯普林斯 1955 年动工的纪念碑谷高速公路则在 1960 年 7 月完工。州际公路系统随后把这些城市快速路缝合起来。

第一条真正跨越州界的连接是向北的。科罗拉多自威灵顿以北至州界的十七英里，与怀俄明通往夏延的九英里衔接段，建于 1962 年 7 月至 1964 年 10 月之间。南向的连接则艰难得多：从特立尼达到拉顿山口的爬坡在十三英里内上升约 1,800 英尺。勘测始于 1959 年，施工于 1960 年从山口顶部开始并向下推进，穿过特立尼达的路段 1963 年开放双向通行，而当地最后一座高架桥直到 1968 年才完工。
科罗拉多段于 1969 年 9 月 21 日（星期日）建成，21 英里长的瓦尔森堡至特立尼达路段在两镇之间的拉格比休息区举行通车典礼。这次通车使自新墨西哥至怀俄明的 299 英里实现四车道连续贯通。

en: For decades the weak point was an eighteen-mile stretch between Castle Rock and Monument, the only four-lane section on the road between Denver and Colorado Springs — Colorado's two largest cities. It had two lanes each way and shoulders too narrow to pull a crash out of the travel lane, so a single incident blocked the corridor.

Colorado DOT rebuilt it between September 2018 and November 2022, using construction manager/general contractor delivery, which the department credited with saving about two years against its usual design-bid-build process. The work widened the road, added an express lane in each direction, rebuilt five bridges, built four wildlife crossings, added a southbound truck climbing lane over Monument Hill and a chain-up station at Larkspur, and removed a left-hand merge.

Tolling of the new express lanes began in January 2024, with two pricing zones in each direction, free passage for carpools with transponders, motorcycles and buses, and a flat surcharge for heavy trucks.
zh: 数十年来，薄弱环节是城堡岩与纪念碑镇之间的十八英里——这是丹佛与科罗拉多斯普林斯（科罗拉多两大城市）之间唯一的四车道路段。它双向各两车道，路肩窄到无法把事故车辆拖出行车道，因此一起事故就能堵死整条走廊。
科罗拉多州交通部于 2018 年 9 月至 2022 年 11 月间将其重建，采用「施工管理／总承包」模式；该部门认为此模式比其惯用的设计—招标—施工流程节省了约两年时间。工程加宽了道路，双向各增设一条快速车道，重建五座桥梁，新建四处野生动物通道，在纪念碑山增设南行货车爬坡车道及拉克斯珀装链站，并取消了一处左侧合流。
新快速车道自 2024 年 1 月起收费，每个方向划分两个计价区段；持有转发器的拼车车辆、摩托车与公交车免费通行，重型货车则须缴纳固定附加费。

value.en: $913.6 million — New Mexico $450.6 million, Colorado $236.4 million, Wyoming $226.6 million. State and federal funds combined, in dollars of the day, as tabulated by FHWA at the close of the Interstate Construction programme; it excludes reconstruction after 1989.
value.zh: 9.136 亿美元——新墨西哥 4.506 亿、科罗拉多 2.364 亿、怀俄明 2.266 亿美元。州与联邦资金合计，按当年美元计，为联邦公路管理局在州际建设计划收尾时的统计口径；不含 1989 年以后的改建。

figures.source: FHWA, Interstate System engineering data, Part III – Cost: estimated cost of individual Interstate routes, 1991 Interstate Cost Estimate (data as of 31 December 1989)

why.en: New Mexico, Colorado and Wyoming each publish their own segment counts. The Denver section and the stretch north of Cheyenne differ by more than an order of magnitude, and no agency averages them.
why.zh: 新墨西哥、科罗拉多与怀俄明各自发布本州路段计数。丹佛段与夏延以北路段的差距超过一个数量级，且没有机构对其取平均值。

label.zh: 「缺口」改建中的野生动物措施

value.en: Four new wildlife crossings plus deer guards along the corridor, built to reduce wildlife–vehicle collisions
value.zh: 沿走廊新建四处野生动物通道并设置防鹿栅栏，以减少动物与车辆碰撞

conditionFigures.source: Colorado DOT, quoted by The Gazette, December 2022

timeline.en: Denver begins building the Valley Highway, the oldest part of the route.
timeline.zh: 丹佛开始修建河谷高速公路，这是本路线最早的一段。

timeline.en: The Valley Highway in Denver is fully open.
timeline.zh: 丹佛河谷高速公路全线通车。

timeline.en: Construction starts at the summit of Raton Pass; Colorado Springs finishes its freeway in July.
timeline.zh: 拉顿山口顶部动工；科罗拉多斯普林斯的高速公路于 7 月建成。

timeline.en: The Colorado–Wyoming link opens on 11 October.
timeline.zh: 科罗拉多—怀俄明衔接段于 10 月 11 日通车。

timeline.en: The last elevated viaduct through Trinidad opens, completing four divided lanes through the town.
timeline.zh: 特立尼达最后一座高架桥通车，该镇实现四车道分隔通行。

timeline.en: The final Colorado segment is dedicated on 21 September, giving 299 continuous miles from New Mexico to Wyoming.
timeline.zh: 科罗拉多最后一段于 9 月 21 日举行通车典礼，自新墨西哥至怀俄明 299 英里连续贯通。

timeline.en: Reconstruction of the Castle Rock–Monument Gap begins in September.
timeline.zh: 城堡岩至纪念碑镇「缺口」段改建于 9 月动工。

timeline.en: The Gap project is completed in November.
Tolling of the Gap express lanes begins in January.
timeline.zh: 「缺口」快速车道于 1 月开始收费。
